title: Horizontal Shrink: y = f(2x)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Explain how the graph of y=f(2x) is obtained from the graph of y=f(x), and identify the point corresponding to a feature originally at x=4.

steps.title: Match Function Values
steps.explanation: The new curve reaches the old value f(a) halfway to where the old curve reached it.

steps.title: State the Scaling
steps.explanation: Every point keeps its height but its distance from the y-axis is halved: a horizontal shrink toward the y-axis by a factor of 1/2.
steps.why: Multiplying the input by k > 1 compresses the graph horizontally by 1/k.

steps.title: Locate the Shifted Feature
steps.explanation: A feature (say an intercept or peak) at horizontal position 4 now appears at position 2, since 2x=4 requires x=2.
steps.why: Applying the map a -> a/2 with a=4.

steps.title: Describe the Sketch
steps.explanation: The curve looks the same but pinched toward the y-axis; points on the y-axis (x=0) remain fixed.
steps.why: x=0 is the only input satisfying x=x/2, so that column is stationary.
